svg.title: Measured FF timing across workload groups

cc:Work.dc:title: Measured FF timing across workload groups
cc:Work.dc:description: Five groups, seven visible targets each. Values are unweighted geometric means of casewise modeled-time ratios to single-cycle at the embedded profile's certified clocks. The groups are not combined.
